scope: signed Browser and Driver archive downloads in Node.js, Python, Java, and .NET SDKs
rules: Start one monotonic deadline immediately before the first archive request.
Retry a transport failure or listed HTTP status only while attempts and deadline remain.
Discard partial archive bytes before each retry; never append to a failed response.
Do not retry authorization, ticket expiry, invalid URL, redirect, size or SHA-256 failures.
Caller cancellation is terminal; never retry it.
Keep signed artifact size, SHA-256 and Browser/Driver pairing verification mandatory before installation.
